run_ungzip_script: run the ungzip.py script to decompress a gzip file and write raw bytes to stdout
test_ungzip_script: test the ungzip.py script by passing a gzip file path as a command-line argument
review_ungzip_script: review the ungzip.py script that reads a gzip file via sys.argv[1] and writes decompressed data to stdout
summarize_ungzip_script: summarize the ungzip.py script which decompresses a gzip file and outputs binary data to stdout
refactor_ungzip_script: refactor the ungzip.py script to use argparse instead of sys.argv for the input file argument
